"None": Default state. Nothing happened so far.
"OK assignment": The machine was successfully created in the manufacturer's cloud.
"KO assignment": The machine was not successfully created in the manufacturer's cloud.
"OK un-assignment": The machine was successfully removed in the manufacturer's cloud.
"KO un-assignment": The machine was not successfully removed in the manufacturer's cloud.
"TKO" : Technical KO due to a timeout.
"KO assignment Without TM": Telemonitoring for the created machine was not successfully stopped in the manufacturer's cloud.
"OK assignment Without TM": Telemonitoring for the created machine was successfully stopped in the manufacturer's cloud.

& IF(FLOOR( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate)* 24, 24 ) )>0,TEXT( FLOOR( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate)* 24, 24 ) ) ) & " hours ","")
& TEXT( ROUND( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate)* 24 * 60, 60 ), 0 ) ) & " minutes "
& TEXT( ROUND( MOD( (ClosedDate - CreatedDate)* 24 * 60*60, 60 ), 0 ) ) & " seconds",
""
)

"&solmgr=1" +

"&queryid=[therapy]0Q_021UAI978521," +
"[asset]0Q_019UAI957741," +
"[consumable]0Q_012UAA370415,"+
"[image]0Q_020UAI805264," +
"[patient]0Q_018UAI583253," +
"[posology]0Q_022UAI612363," +
"[workOrder]0Q_005EAA101089," +
"[task]0Q_006EAA720866," +
"[prescription]0Q_007EAA846887," +
"[dvp]0Q_008EAA574948," +
"[dvpHeader]0Q_009EAA874048," +
"[questionnaire]0Q_010EAA682085" +
"&templateid=" + TEKCO_TemplateKey__c +
"&qmode=Attachments" +
"&DefaultPDF=1" +
"&OFN=" & IF(
        ISBLANK(TEKCO_ParentReport__c),
        IF(
        !ISBLANK(TEKCO_Therapy__r.PASCO_Patient__r.FirstName),
        TEKCO_Therapy__r.PASCO_Patient__r.FirstName & " ",
        ""
        )
        & TEKCO_Therapy__r.PASCO_Patient__r.LastName & " " & TEKCO_Therapy__r.PASCO_TherapyTypeName__c & " " & TEXT(TODAY()),
        ""
        ) &
"&UF0=1&MFTS0=TEKCO_Status__c&MFTSValue0=Completed"

fields.label: Readiness for sync
fields.formula:
IF (
    CXFCO_OutboundConfig__c != "NONE",
	IF (
		OR(
			AND(
                           NOT(ISPICKVAL(WOMCO_Therapy__r.CXFCO_Status__c, "04")),
                           NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'OSMIT_B2BWorkOrder')
                        ),
			AND(
                           NOT(ISPICKVAL(ServiceContract.CXFCO_Status__c, "04")),
                           RecordType.DeveloperName = 'OSMIT_B2BWorkOrder'
                        ),
		        AND(
                           OR(
                              NOT(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD")), 
                              AND(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD"), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ACCCO_Patient') 
                           ), 
                           NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Type, "055")), 
                           NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.CXFCO_Status__c, "04"))
			),
			AND(
               OR(
                   NOT(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD")), 
                   AND(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD"), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ACCCO_Patient')
               ), 
               ISPICKVAL(Account.Type, "055"),
               NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Parent.CXFCO_Status__c, "04"))
			)
		),
		$Label.CXFCO_RelatedParentsAreNotSynced & " " & 
                IF(AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(WOMCO_Therapy__r.CXFCO_Status__c, "04")),
                           NOT( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'OSMIT_B2BWorkOrder')
                        ), 
HYPERLINK("/"&WOMCO_Therapy__r.Id, "Therapy", "_self") & ";", '') & IF(AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(ServiceContract.CXFCO_Status__c, "04")),
                           RecordType.DeveloperName = 'OSMIT_B2BWorkOrder' ), 
HYPERLINK("/"&ServiceContract.Id, "Service Contract", "_self") & ";", '') & " " & IF(
			AND(
                OR(
                   NOT(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD")), 
                   AND(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD"), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ACCCO_Patient')
                ), 
            ISPICKVAL(Account.Type, "055"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Parent.CXFCO_Status__c, "04"))), 
			HYPERLINK("/"&Account.Parent.Id, "Account", "_self") & ";", 
			IF(
				AND(
                    OR(
                      NOT(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD")), 
                      AND(ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "NLD"), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ACCCO_Patient')
                    ),
                   NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Type, "055")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.CXFCO_Status__c, "04"))),
				HYPERLINK("/"&Account.Id, "Account", "_self") & ";",'')
		),
					IF((ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "ITA") && TEKCO_LineItemsWithGenericProduct__c > 0),
					  $Label.CXFCO_GenericProductRecordIsNotReadyToSync,
					  IF(
				            AND(
					            ISPICKVAL(TEKCO_Country__c, "SBL"),
					            OR(
						          ISBLANK(PASCO_Warehouse__c),
						          AND(
							         NOT(ISBLANK(PASCO_Warehouse__c)) ,
							         ISBLANK(PASCO_Warehouse__r.TEKCO_FHIRId__c)
						          )
					            )
  				               ),
				               $Label.CXFCO_WarehouseRecordValidation,
				               $Label.CXFCO_RecordIsReadyToSync
			            )
				      )
				),
				$Label.CXFCO_RecordIsNotReadyToSync
)
